hook: Telangana Class 10 exams likely to start *March 17 or 18*
hook_b: Telangana Class 10 exams likely to start *March 17 or 18*
tldr: The School Education Department has sent the SSC 2027 timetable to the government for approval; the tentative schedule starts on March 17 or 18.

beats.what: The timetable is still tentative until the government approves it.
beats.why: Exam fees are now in the late-fee window: Rs 50 extra until December 1, then Rs 200 and Rs 500 slabs.
beats.care: Fees go to school headmasters: Rs 125 for more than three subjects, Rs 110 for up to three.
